decisions.question: Which exported functions and classes does the facade offer?
decisions.why: every exported function or class that is async or yields a handle

decisions.question: Which method releases a Mail, so acquiring one opens a scope? ("none" keeps it unscoped)
Which events of Mail does the facade offer as Streams? ("none" for none)
Which method releases a Transport, so acquiring one opens a scope? ("none" keeps it unscoped)
decisions.why: its type has no release method

decisions.question: Which events of Transport does the facade offer as Streams? ("none" for none)
Which method releases a Logger, so acquiring one opens a scope? ("none" keeps it unscoped)
decisions.why: its type has no release method

decisions.question: Which events of Logger does the facade offer as Streams? ("none" for none)
Which upstream failures become which tagged errors?
decisions.why: exported error classes, most specific first, then the catch-all NodemailerError carrying `code` (the source sets ECONNECTION, EAUTH, EENVELOPE, EPROTOCOL, ETLS, EMESSAGE)

decisions.question: Which handles are provided as services (Context.Service with a layer)?
decisions.why: every offered export that acquires a releasable handle

decisions.question: Why a second revision of this upstream version?
decisions.why: the engine now wraps handles held in properties (puppeteer page.keyboard and page.mouse were raw upstream objects whose methods returned promises)
